description: Source code for Linux DNS configuration service in Chromium, handling reading and watching DNS resolver configuration files, converting resolver state to internal DNS config, and managing DNS-related system files.

classes.name: DnsConfigServiceLinux::Watcher
classes.description: Watches DNS configuration files for changes and triggers reconfiguration.

classes.name: DnsConfigServiceLinux::ConfigReader
classes.description: Reads DNS configuration asynchronously using libresolv and converts it to internal format.

classes.name: DnsConfigServiceLinux::ConfigReader::WorkItem
classes.description: Performs the actual work of reading and converting DNS resolver state.

methods.name: DnsConfigServiceLinux::DnsConfigServiceLinux
methods.description: Constructor, initializes the DNS config service.

methods.name: DnsConfigServiceLinux::~DnsConfigServiceLinux
methods.description: Destructor, cancels ongoing config reading if any.

methods.name: DnsConfigServiceLinux::ReadConfigNow
methods.description: Triggers an immediate DNS configuration read.

methods.name: DnsConfigServiceLinux::StartWatching
methods.description: Starts watching DNS configuration files for changes.

methods.name: DnsConfigServiceLinux::CreateReader
methods.description: Creates a new ConfigReader instance for reading DNS configs.
